name: Kimishima Saki
source:
A first-year middle school girl who participates in the extracurricular camp, but was cast aside by her friends. She stresses her feelings for better or worse, and her personality remains unchanged even when she wanders into another world. Her freewheeling and honest personality means she says exactly what is on her mind, which may lead to friction against others. She is unable to accept death as a reality, and believes everything is going to be alright.

Her digimon partner is Floramon.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2020/01/digimon-survive-details-saki-kimijima-floramon-and-free-action]Gematsu's translation[/url]]
